headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red after volatile trade while Nifty gained 75 points amid global cues.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following a volatile trading session.
Nifty managed to gain 75 points despite broader market pressure.
Concerns over FII outflows and crude oil price volatility weighed on sentiment.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East impacted global market stability.
whatHappening: Investors are focusing on the upcoming three-day bank strike starting Monday.
Semiconductor ecosystem development faces cyberattack warnings from the IT ministry.
Tata Sons boardroom battles remain a key point of interest for investors.
Small-cap stocks showed mixed performance compared to front-line indices.
summary: The Indian market ended the last session on a mixed note with Nifty gaining 75 points while Sensex slipped. Investors are cautious due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and an upcoming three-day bank strike. Focus remains on the semiconductor ecosystem and Tata Group boardroom developments.
